import seaborn as sns
from collections import Counter
from textblob import TextBlob
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt

    if not isinstance(n, int) or n <= 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be a positive integer")
    if not isinstance(top_k, int) or top_k < 0:
        raise ValueError("top_k must be a non-negative integer")

    blob = TextBlob(str(text).lower())
    ngram_strs = [" ".join(gram) for gram in blob.ngrams(n=n)]
    top_ngrams = Counter(ngram_strs).most_common(top_k)

    df = pd.DataFrame(top_ngrams, columns=["n-gram", "Frequency"])

    plt.figure()
    if not df.empty:
        sns.barplot(x="n-gram", y="Frequency", data=df)
    plt.xlabel("n-gram")
    plt.ylabel("Frequency")
    plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha="right")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
